requirement R4 Both curves: P-256 and P-384 public keys read correctly
requirement R5 Subject and issuer can be the same (self-signed) or different, independent of CA status
requirement R6 A certificate with no BasicConstraints extension at all defaults to CA:false, no path length
requirement E2E A realistic small set of certificates mixing every rule above in one input
